cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm cozy kawaii aesthetic, premium quality. A cute kawaii capybara with big sparkly eyes and rosy cheeks, sitting contentedly in a steaming Japanese onsen hot spring surrounded by smooth river rocks. The capybara wears a tiny yuzu orange on its head. Around the hot spring: a wooden bucket with a small towel draped over the edge, a bamboo ladle, and floating yuzu citrus fruits in the water. Steam rises in soft curls. In the background, snow-dusted bamboo groves and a traditional wooden fence with a paper lantern glowing warmly. Soft pink cherry blossom petals drift through the air. Warm golden evening light with peach and coral tones. Serene, relaxing, and utterly adorable spa atmosphere. NO text in the image.
